number-sense.name: Number Sense
number-sense.description: Work with fractions, decimals, negatives and powers until each one feels like an amount, not a rule.

ratio.name: Ratio and Percentages
ratio.description: Turn percentages and ratios into tools for comparing prices, growth and exchange rates.

equations.name: Equations and Inequalities
equations.description: Solve equations by keeping both sides in balance, then use them to find unknown prices.

functions.name: Functions and Graphs
functions.description: Read a function as a machine and its graph as a picture, then build new functions from old ones.

quadratics.name: Quadratics
quadratics.description: Factorise, solve and sketch quadratics, then find the price that maximises revenue.

exp-log.name: Exponentials and Logarithms
exp-log.description: See why repeated growth explodes, and use logarithms to ask how many steps it took.

trig.name: Trigonometry
trig.description: Start from right-angled triangles and unroll the unit circle into waves.

series.name: Sequences and Series
series.description: Find the rule behind a sequence, add it up, and value a stream of payments.

counting.name: Counting and Vectors
counting.description: Count choices without listing them, then meet vectors as arrows you can add and scale.

terminal.name: Your Machine and the Terminal
terminal.description: Find your way around your own machine and run a script from the terminal.

first-python.name: First Python Scripts
first-python.description: Write your first Python scripts: values, decisions, loops, functions and files.

mental.name: Mental Arithmetic Drills
mental.description: Build the mental arithmetic habits that keep a two-minute score climbing.

py-found.name: Python Foundations
py-found.description: Write Python you can trust: core types, functions, modules, classes and simple tests.

numpy-pandas.name: NumPy and pandas
numpy-pandas.description: Handle price data in arrays and tables, from returns to rolling volatility.

plotting.name: Plotting Market Data
plotting.description: Draw clear, honest charts of prices, returns and drawdowns.

git.name: Git and the Command Line
git.description: Keep every version of your work, and share it on GitHub.

sql.name: SQL Basics
sql.description: Ask a database questions, from one table to several joined together.

pytest.name: Testing with pytest
pytest.description: Write tests that catch your mistakes before they reach a backtest.

limits.name: Limits and Derivatives
limits.description: Shrink a secant into a tangent, then use derivatives to measure sensitivity and find optima.

integrals.name: Integrals
integrals.description: Add up thin slices to find areas, totals and averages.

taylor.name: Series and Approximation
taylor.description: Approximate hard functions with polynomials and learn how far to trust them.

multivar.name: Multivariable Calculus
multivar.description: Extend calculus to several inputs: gradients, constrained optima and double integrals.

vectors.name: Vectors and Matrices
vectors.description: Treat vectors as portfolios and matrices as transformations of space.

elimination.name: Elimination and Rank
elimination.description: Solve systems by elimination and count how many independent directions a matrix keeps.

least-squares.name: Orthogonality and Least Squares
least-squares.description: Project onto a subspace and fit the best line when no exact answer exists.

eigen.name: Eigenvalues and the SVD
eigen.description: Find the directions a matrix only stretches, and use the SVD to pull structure out of data.

counting-chance.name: Counting and Chance
counting-chance.description: Count outcomes carefully and turn the counts into probabilities.

conditional.name: Conditional Probability
conditional.description: Update a probability when you learn something. Build to Bayes’ rule and use it on trades.

random-vars.name: Random Variables
random-vars.description: Attach numbers to outcomes, then measure their average, their spread and how they move together.

limits-thm.name: Distributions and Limit Theorems
limits-thm.description: Meet the named distributions and see why averages settle and sums look normal.

markov.name: Markov Chains and Random Walks
markov.description: Model processes that forget their past, from market regimes to a gambler’s ruin.

estimation.name: Estimation
estimation.description: Estimate unknown quantities from data and say how far off you might be.

testing.name: Hypothesis Testing
testing.description: Decide whether a result could be luck, and avoid fooling yourself across many tests.

regression.name: Linear Regression
regression.description: Fit lines to data, read every number in the output, and know when to distrust it.

markets.name: Markets and Instruments
markets.description: Value cash flows over time and learn what bonds, shares and futures really are.

options.name: Options and Payoffs
options.description: Draw option payoffs, combine them into strategies, and derive put-call parity.

trees.name: Pricing with Trees
trees.description: Price an option by building its hedge on a binomial tree, then let the steps shrink.

micro.name: Market Microstructure
micro.description: See how an order book works, what trading really costs, and how market makers quote.

algo-think.name: Algorithmic Thinking
algo-think.description: Measure how algorithms scale, and solve problems by recursion, searching and sorting.

ds.name: Core Data Structures
ds.description: Choose the right data structure and turn slow nested loops into a single pass.

graphs-dp.name: Graphs and Dynamic Programming
graphs-dp.description: Search graphs, find shortest paths, and solve hard problems by remembering subproblems.

cpp.name: C++ Foundations
cpp.description: Learn C++ from a first compiled program to classes, memory and the standard library.

cpp-pricing.name: C++ for Pricing
cpp-pricing.description: Rewrite your pricers in C++, test them, and measure the speed-up.

stat-learning.name: Statistical Learning
stat-learning.description: Fit models that predict well on data they have not seen.

validation.name: Validation and Leakage
validation.description: Measure a model honestly when data arrives in time order and leaks are everywhere.

ensembles.name: Trees and Ensembles
ensembles.description: Grow decision trees and combine them into forests and boosted models.

fin-ml.name: Financial Machine Learning
fin-ml.description: Apply machine learning to markets: labels, features, position sizing and honest evaluation.

arma.name: Stationarity and ARMA
arma.description: Test whether a series is stable over time and model how it remembers its past.

garch.name: Volatility and GARCH
garch.description: Model how volatility clusters, and forecast risk from it.

coint.name: Cointegration
coint.description: Find price series that drift together and trade the gap between them.

backtest.name: Backtesting Engine
backtest.description: Build a backtesting engine that charges costs, refuses to peek, and reports honestly.

alpha.name: Alpha Signal Research
alpha.description: Research cross-sectional signals and measure what survives after costs.

opt-dash.name: Options Analytics Dashboard
opt-dash.description: Build a dashboard of implied volatility and Greeks from real option chains.

contests.name: Contest Practice
contests.description: Solve timed algorithm problems and learn to pick your battles in a contest.

momentum-rep.name: Replicating Momentum
momentum-rep.description: Reproduce the momentum effect from the original paper and test it on later data.

pairs-rep.name: Replicating Pairs Trading
pairs-rep.description: Reproduce the classic pairs trading study and measure how much of the profit remains.

ito.name: Brownian Motion and Itô
ito.description: Build Brownian motion from coin flips and derive the Black-Scholes equation.

puzzles.name: Probability Puzzles
puzzles.description: Solve interview probability puzzles cold, with the shortest clean argument.

mm-games.name: Market-Making Games
mm-games.description: Quote two-sided prices on unknown quantities and update them as trades arrive.

mental-pressure.name: Mental Maths Under Pressure
mental-pressure.description: Push mental arithmetic to interview speed against a clock.
